title: Bill Gates-backed malaria nets helped fight disease, but are harming African waters
content: In various regions of Africa, the repurposing of insecticide-treated mosquito nets for fishing is becoming a growing trend. This alarming practice not only jeopardizes fish populations but also poses a serious threat to fragile aquatic ecosystems. Food-insecure families find this adaptation as a quick fix, but the harmful chemicals in the nets could also endanger marine life. A comprehensive strategy is essential to harmonize health measures with ecological integrity.

title: Pakistan cricket hit by political turmoil! PCB shifts President’s Trophy matches
content: The Pakistan Cricket Board has taken the decisive step to relocate President's Trophy matches amidst ongoing political unrest. With governor's rule now imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, several matches planned for that area are being moved. While Peshawar and Abbottabad's fixtures are affected, games will continue in Islamabad and Rawalpindi. Starting October 14, matches will be held in Sheikhupura and Lahore, illustrating how political issues are shaping the domestic cricket landscape.

title: How India travels: A tale of two wheels and many divides
content: India's commuting landscape shows noticeable variations influenced by geography, gender, and age demographics. Two-wheelers remain popular, but there's an increasing reliance on buses and walking in certain regions. For students, biking and bus usage is higher in urban areas compared to rural settings. Gender disparity persists, with more male workers using two-wheelers while women predominantly walk or take buses.

title: Australia removed rabbits; petrel colony grew to over 800 breeding pairs
content: After the successful elimination of rabbits from Cabbage Tree Island, conservationists observed a remarkable increase in the Gould’s petrel population. This pivotal action mitigated serious threats to their habitat and reproductive success, leading to over 800 breeding pairs by 2000, with annual offspring exceeding 400. To further bolster the species, a second breeding colony was initiated on Boondelbah Island, emphasizing the need for ongoing protective measures.

title: Michael Dell’s Florida resort sells 40% of luxury condos, starting at $8.95m
content: Michael Dell's investment in Boca Raton's luxury real estate has already resulted in approximately 40% of the condos being sold. The residences offer high-end amenities and multiple perks, including a top-tier resort membership for family members. The project represents a significant shift for a century-old resort previously focused on rental accommodations. Construction is expected to begin later this year, with completion anticipated in 2029.

title: Google DeepMind will pay ‘very good vibe coders’ up to $1.1 million, no degree needed
content: Google DeepMind is hiring engineers for Polaris, a new team that builds hand-crafted tests to measure Gemini's software engineering skills. Total compensation ranges from $550,000 to $1.1 million, and no degree is required. Tamay Besiroglu, whose team runs the interviews, says the company wants people who are smart and can solve hard problems. Experience with AI coding agents helps, and there are no LeetCode questions.

title: Bronze Age child burials reveal gender-linked funeral customs 4,000 years ago
content: The study of burial practices in Bronze Age Serbia indicates that children’s funerary treatment varied by biological sex, with research focused on two Maros culture cemeteries. Boys and girls were interred in contrasting ways, highlighting established gender roles. Interestingly, some burials challenged these customs, inviting reflection on societal standards. This work sheds light on the nuances of how ancient communities perceived and enacted gender distinctions in funerary rituals.

title: 2,300-year-old shipwreck off Croatia yields rare pottery and wooden remains
content: A significant shipwreck has been discovered off the Croatian island of Vis, containing artifacts from the Hellenistic period. Archaeologists recovered various objects, including pottery, wooden remains, and personal items from the merchant vessel. The findings date back approximately 2,300 years, shedding light on ancient maritime commerce. Unique discoveries include drinking vessels, a coin from ancient Pharos, and parts of the ship's wooden structure.

title: Francis Ford Coppola turned abandoned Belize lodge into 20-room resort
content: In 1981, filmmaker Francis Ford Coppola bought an abandoned hunting lodge in the forests of Belize and turned it into a private family retreat. Twelve years later, it opened as Blancaneaux Lodge, a 20-room resort. The property has retained much of its original character, with cottages, wooden interiors and outdoor activities including kayaking, horse riding and swimming near waterfalls.

title: US-based couple with Rs 4.78 crore plans India return, weighs early retirement
content: In their 30s and feeling the weight of demanding careers, a couple is contemplating a return to India after amassing Rs 4.78 crore through smart investments and asset acquisitions in the U.S. They are increasingly exhausted and exploring the benefits of a lower-stress lifestyle. With thoughts of starting a family and its financial implications, they seek advice on whether to continue their grind or prioritize their personal health and happiness.

title: Armed with torpedoes, sonar and rockets: Navy inducts submarine hunter INS Mangrol
content: INS Mangrol, the third Mahe-class Anti-Submarine Warfare vessel, has been commissioned by the Indian Navy. This new craft is designed to address submarine threats effectively in shallow waters. It carries advanced detection and warfare systems while being largely manufactured domestically, reflecting India's shipbuilding capabilities. The vessel will enhance coastal security and perform various maritime operations alongside other naval assets.

title: Meet Abhay Kumar Pandey, Indian researcher named among world’s top 2% scientists
content: Celebrated mycologist Dr Abhay Kumar Pandey has once again been ranked among the Top 2% Scientists globally. His groundbreaking research focuses on combating fungal diseases that threaten tea plants in Assam and North Bengal, utilizing beneficial microorganisms for sustainable solutions. With over 60 research publications to his name, Pandey’s accomplishments highlight the significant contributions of Indian scientists to the international research landscape.

title: RBI measures see sharp impact as rupee rises 1% against US dollar

Despite Monday's sharp rise, the rupee has lost 6.6% against the dollar so far this year. On Saturday, the RBI announced a set of measures targeting two major sources of pressure on the rupee.

title: Kevin Durant’s $10m college center serves 200 students a year, 96% get accepted
content: Kevin Durant has committed $10 million to help students access higher education in his Maryland community. This initiative supports over 200 students each year, with a college acceptance rate exceeding 96%. The Durant Center, opened in January 2019, provides resources for students from underserved backgrounds. College Track assists participants from ninth grade through college to overcome barriers. Durant's foundation aims to positively impact local youth by enhancing their educational opportunities.

title: Texas family ends 8-year fight over 65,000-acre ranch worth at least $60m
content: After years of contention, the heirs of the historic Brite Ranch have finally reached an agreement to split the vast 65,000-acre estate. This ranch, steeped in family history, has faced scrutiny from a court case launched in 2018 that revealed turmoil over trust management and financial allocation. Though lingering issues persist, this resolution is a significant step toward preserving the ranch and averting its sale.

title: After 16-coach launch, Railways plans 24-coach Vande Bharat sleeper with pantry

Three major manufacturing projects are underway. The 24-coach Vande Bharat sleeper trains will be a variant of the existing train design but will include a pantry car.

title: Record alert! Tilak Varma joins elite club with India's best catch ratio in T20Is
content: Tilak Varma achieved a significant milestone by making 50 catches in T20Is against West Indies. This accomplishment makes him the fifth Indian fielder to reach this landmark. His efficiency is notable, with a dismissals-per-innings ratio of 0.757, the best among Indian players. In the match, he was involved in an unusual run-out but contributed 28 runs. India eventually won the match by 14 runs, leading the series 2-1.

title: Kolhapur man ‘pushes’ girlfriend into 1,000ft valley after family fixes her marriage

He initially claimed Tarrannum fell into the valley, but chat history indicated he was upset about her arranged marriage. title: Michigan couple loses court fight over 50-foot strip claimed through deed error

The couple, who bought their land at a 2015 tax sale, argued that previous owners had used the disputed area for decades. However, two surveys placed the land within their neighbour's property. On October 9, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals ruled against the couple, citing insufficient evidence to establish ownership.

title: San Francisco church converted into luxury homes; one sells for $6.65 million

title: Passenger's device catches fire, Delhi-Chennai flight diverted
content: an IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai was diverted to Hyderabad . crew put the device in water before the aircraft safely diverted . the personal electronic device (PED) caught fire was kept in overhead baggage . many countries mandate that such devices be kept in front of passengers .

title: Delhi protests: SC on Tuesday to hear pleas on attacks on protesters, lawyers
content: the suprem court agreed to hear two separate pleas on Tuesday . alleged hooligans accused of attacking lawyers and protesters . the court said it would not allow the court to become a political battleground . senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan mentioned a plea seeking action .

title: Watch: Moment missile hit Riyadh airport; 13 killed, including Indian national
content: footage captures the moments surrounding the impact . the missile strike on sunday killed 13 people and injured more than 300 others . an Indian national was among those killed, while 11 Indians were injured, the embassy in Riyadh says .

title: INDIA bloc fumes as CJI declines meeting request; Raut says ‘people will remember this’
content: opposition leaders criticise chief justice of india's request for meeting over 'vote chori' . the opposition's reaction comes as the INDIA bloc has planned a protest march towards the Supreme Court on Monday .

title: ‘This govt will go’: Shashi Tharoor ahead of Congress march to Supreme Court
content: senior Congress leader Shashi Tharoor reiterated the opposition’s slogan against the Modi-led government . the remarks come amid mounting opposition criticism of the Centre over its handling of the controversy surrounding the CEC and the Election Commission’s SIR exercise .

title: ‘Salt rubbed into wounds’: 3 men allege electric shocks, torture at BJP MLA’s house in UP
content: three men allege torture at BJP MLA's house in UP . they allege a missing gold bracelet belonging to the legislator's son . no case had been registered so far, police said . police are investigating allegations that three men were illegally confined and tortured .

title: Watch: Tanker off Oman catches fire after drone attack; two of 11 Indians missing
content: a tanker carrying 11 Indian seafarers came under a drone attack at Sohar Anchorage . nine of our Indian crew members have been successfully rescued and are safe . search-and-rescue operations are underway by the local coast guard .

title: Jantar Mantar no longer a protest site; three new venues designated
content: the ministry of home affairs constituted a committee to examine alternative venues . the decision was taken based on the committee's recommendations . three alternative venues designated for organising protests and demonstrations are named . a new protest site has been de-notified as a protest site .

title: 'Keep getting messages': Rahul's big claim, and a message for CEC Gyanesh Kumar
content: leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha says 200 government officials are in touch with the opposition . he says he was having "sleepless nights" amid the opposition's campaign against electoral irregularities . the chief election commissioner claims he had been "ganesh Kumar" and the Narendra Modi-led Centre .
